why: A German adjective used adverbially is the same word uninflected, so carding it as an adverb is not wrong about the word — it is wrong about what the app can then do with it. Only adjective cards get de-inflection, so «ein plötzlicher Regen», «die gegenseitige Hilfe» and «unabhängige Medien» resolved to nothing at all, and an example written that way is refused by the authoring gate.
